accessible_toilet.note: Step-free from the access area in the stalls

sources.quote: There are good site lines to the stage with step free entry to our access toilet, which is located within the gender neutral toilet block.

alt_accessible_entrance.note: A ramp at the side of the venue on Severus Road

sources.quote: We can provide ramped access into our venue at the side of the venue on Severus Road.

assistance_dogs.note: Trained assistance dogs; tell them ahead

sources.quote: Trained assistance dogs are welcome in our venue.

notes: The access area is in the stalls, on the left facing the stage; most events are run by promoters who hire the venue. The listings name no screen.

sources.quote: although we usually have things in place such as quiet rooms

step_free_access.note: By ramp at the side, on Severus Road; not to the circles

sources.quote: We can provide ramped access into our venue at the side of the venue on Severus Road.
Unfortunately we do not have step free access to the circle or upper circle of the venue, and the bar in the stalls is located 5 steps up from our access area.
